title: The Scrutiny & Filing Congestion Loop
path: Filing Errors → Burden on Court Staff → Scrutiny Backlog → Time Taken to Scrutinize → Length of Scrutiny Period → Filing Errors
mechanism: High defect rates in filing documents increase verification burden on staff, multiplying scrutiny backlog and lengthening turnaround times, which compounds filing errors.

title: The Early Settlement & Deterrence Loop
path: Statutory Notice → Understanding Notice → Perceived Accountability → Willingness to Pay → Share of Dues Paid → Statutory Notice
mechanism: Prompt and clear statutory notice establishes immediate legal exposure and perceived accountability, encouraging accused parties to settle early prior to formal docketing.

title: Summons Service & Timely Appearance Loop
path: Verified Address → Use of Reputable Courier → Speed of Service → Summons Effectively Served → Likelihood Accused Receives Summons → Chances Accused Appears in Court → Hearings Proceed → Verified Address
mechanism: Accurate verified addresses allow swift summons delivery through formal couriers, substantially raising the probability of timely court appearance and scheduled hearing completion.

title: The Adjournment & Caseload Compounding Loop
path: Number of Cases → Frequency of Adjournments → Backlog (Operational) → Gap Between Hearings → Schedulability of Magistrate & Lawyers → Number of Cases
mechanism: Bloated dockets incentivize lawyers to seek strategic adjournments, inflating operational backlogs and lengthening hearing gaps, further compounding the active caseload.

title: Evasion, Escalation & Police Overburden Loop
path: Tendency to Evade → Case Delay (Warrant Stage) → Magistrate Propensity to Escalate → Severity of Warrants → Burden on Police → Rate of Warrant Execution → Tendency to Evade
mechanism: Persistent non-appearance triggers escalated warrant severity (bailable to non-bailable), overwhelming police capacity, depressing execution rates, and normalizing further evasion.

title: The Litigation Fatigue & Attrition Loop
path: Case Pendency → Money Spent on Case → Mental Conflict Over Escalation → Willingness to Continue → Cases Closed Without Recovery → Case Pendency
mechanism: Endless procedural delays escalate financial expenses and emotional fatigue on complainants, ultimately destroying their willingness to continue and forcing abandoned recoveries.

title: The External Diversion / Mediation Balancing Loop
path: Delay in Pursuing Legal Option → Cost of Seeking Redress → Use of Mediation Outside Court → Willingness to Pay → Settlement / Dispute Exit
mechanism: Excessive litigation delays and expenses drive disputing parties to pursue pre-institution mediation and Lok Adalats, redirecting disputes away from the congested formal docket.

title: Judicial Clearance Pressure Balancing Loop
path: Case Pendency → Pressure to Clear Cases → Cases Referred to Mediation → Resolution Through Court → Cases Reaching Judgement → Case Pendency
mechanism: Mounting pendency mounts administrative pressure on magistrates, accelerating referrals to Lok Adalats and summary disposals to re-stabilize court docket volume.

title: The Non-Appearance Escalation Balancing Loop
path: Extent of Proceedings Frustrated → Magistrate Propensity to Escalate → Severity of Warrants → Police Effort in Pursuing Accused → Rate of Warrant Execution → Number of Arrests → Chances Accused Appears in Court → Extent of Proceedings Frustrated
mechanism: Accused evasion forces judicial escalation through arrest warrants, compelling police enforcement and apprehension, which directly restores accused attendance before the court.
